== Summary ==
Dale Hanak of Virginia Beach, scored a free trip to....Virginia Beach... and a seat at the Star Trek CCG World Finals when he won his second straight regional victory. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999#Star Trek CCG World Championship|Star Trek CCG at DecipherCon 1999]] and [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]].
